corpus_name: PC Bangla Typing App Initial Test Suite

provenance_summary.external_corpora_status: No external datasets imported yet; all initial test cases are original handcrafted examples.

datasets.description: High-frequency Bengali words and phonetic inputs for baseline transliteration testing.
Full sentence-level Banglish inputs with expected contextual Bengali outputs.
Phonetic spelling variation clusters mapping to canonical Bengali words.
Complex Bengali Unicode conjuncts, ligatures, Kar symbols, and modifier test cases.

external_corpora_import_policy: Any future external corpus (e.g. Ankur, Mozilla Bengali, OpenBengali) will undergo strict evidence-based licensing audits and attribution logging before inclusion.
